callees.name: command_stdin
callees.pre_condition: command is a non-empty list of strings
callees.post_condition: Returns the stdin text to feed to the subprocess when the command includes stdin content; returns None when the command has no stdin component

callees.name: command_argv
callees.pre_condition: command is a non-empty list of strings
callees.post_condition: Returns the full command-line argument list to execute, with any stdin component of the command excluded

callees.name: _opencode_env
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a valid directory path and event_id is a non-empty string
callees.post_condition: Returns an environment variable dictionary containing configuration injections derived from work_dir and event_id

callees.name: _write_command_stdin
callees.pre_condition: stdin_pipe is a writable subprocess stdin pipe and stdin_text is a non-empty string
callees.post_condition: Writes all of stdin_text to stdin_pipe and closes the pipe. Returns regardless of write outcome.

callees.name: _copy_opencode_output
callees.pre_condition: stdout_pipe is a readable subprocess stdout pipe and trace_log_path is a writable filesystem path
callees.post_condition: Copies all output from stdout_pipe to the file at trace_log_path until the pipe is exhausted. Returns when the subprocess output stream is closed.
